svg.aria-label: Flowchart for deciding where a rule goes, asked in order and stopping at the first yes. Would breaking it once cost something I can't undo, or have I said it three times? A hook. Does every session in every repo need it? The global CLAUDE.md. Is it a judgment call with a reason? Memory or DECISIONS.md. Is it steps I'd explain again? A skill. Does it need fresh eyes? A subagent. Does it only matter for one kind of task? A knowledge file with an index line. No to all of them: leave it in chat.
